title: US equity funds see outflows on rate-cut uncertainty, AI worries
title_zh: AI担忧降息不确定性导致美国股票基金出现资金外流
summary: Feb 13 (Reuters) - U.S. equity funds recorded outflows in the week to February 11 on worries over AI-related corporate spending and as a stronger jobs report dampened expectations of Federal Reserve
summary_zh: 路透 2 月 13 日 - 截至 2 月 11 日当周，美国股票基金录得资金流出，原因是对人工智能相关企业支出的担忧以及强劲的就业报告打压了美联储的预期

title: EU project to rival Starlink must meet buyer expectations, Eutelsat CEO says
title_zh: 欧洲通信卫星公司首席执行官表示，与星链竞争的欧盟项目必须满足买家的期望
summary: By Gianluca Lo Nostro and Maria Rugamer PARIS, Feb 13 (Reuters) - Eutelsat said on Friday that Europe's planned IRIS2 satellite network must meet customer expectations in terms of pricing and
summary_zh: 路透巴黎 2 月 13 日 - 欧洲通信卫星公司 (Eutelsat) 周五表示，欧洲规划的 IRIS2 卫星网络必须满足客户在定价和服务方面的期望。

title: Gold prices climb ahead of US inflation data
title_zh: 金价在美国通胀数据公布前攀升
summary: Gold prices rose on Friday morning, as investors awaited the release of US inflation data later in the day.
summary_zh: 周五上午金价上涨，因投资者等待当天晚些时候公布的美国通胀数据。

title: Capgemini CEO dismisses calls for full European tech autonomy
title_zh: 凯捷首席执行官驳回了欧洲科技完全自主权的呼吁
summary: Capgemini CEO Aiman Ezzat on Friday dismissed calls for a total technological sovereignty in Europe, at a time when fraying ‌transatlantic relations have stoked concerns about the region's dependence on U.S. tech majors.
summary_zh: 凯捷首席执行官艾曼·埃扎特 (Aiman Ezzat) 周五驳回了欧洲全面技术主权的呼吁，目前跨大西洋关系的紧张引发了人们对该地区对美国科技巨头依赖的担忧。

title: Europe, Asia lead equity fund inflows as US records weekly outflow
title_zh: 欧洲和亚洲引领股票基金流入，而美国创下每周资金流出记录
summary: Feb 13 (Reuters) - European and Asian equity funds drew strong inflows in the week ended February 11 as investors trimmed exposure to U.S. mega-cap stocks on concerns about stretched valuations and
summary_zh: 路透 2 月 13 日 - 截至 2 月 11 日当周，欧洲和亚洲股票基金吸引了大量资金流入，原因是投资者因担心估值过高而削减了对美国大型股的投资。

title: NatWest posts 24% surge in annual profits as it beats estimates
title_zh: NatWest 年度利润飙升 24%，超出预期
summary: NatWest has reported a 24% jump in operating profit for the year, in annual results that beat expectations.
summary_zh: NatWest 报告今年营业利润增长 24%，年度业绩超出预期。

title: Indian IT stocks set to lose $50 billion in worst week since pandemic on AI fears
title_zh: 由于人工智能担忧，印度 IT 股票将损失 500 亿美元，这是自大流行以来最糟糕的一周
summary: By Vivek Kumar M and Nandan Mandayam Feb 13 (Reuters) - Indian IT shares were headed for their worst week since March 2020 on Friday, losing about $50 billion in market value in a rout sparked by
summary_zh: 作者：Vivek Kumar M 和 Nandan Mandayam 2 月 13 日（路透社）——周五，印度 IT 股迎来 2020 年 3 月以来最糟糕的一周，在印度 IT 股引发的暴跌中损失了约 500 亿美元的市值。

title: What is a UK digital gilt, and how can you buy one?
title_zh: 什么是英国数字金边债券？如何购买？
summary: The UK is preparing to issue its first-ever “digital gilt,” a government bond recorded using blockchain technology.
summary_zh: 英国正准备发行首支“数字金边债券”，这是一种使用区块链技术记录的政府债券。

title: 'Our booze-infused business gives smoked salmon a rock and roll persona'
title_zh: “我们的酒类业务赋予熏鲑鱼摇滚风格”
summary: James Eagle founded UK artisan brand The Pished Fish in 2014 and is known for its booze-infused, Scandinavian style smoked salmon.
summary_zh: James Eagle 于 2014 年创立了英国手工品牌 The Pished Fish，以其加酒的斯堪的纳维亚风格熏鲑鱼而闻名。
